assumptions.choice: A breakout is defined as the close crossing from at or below the relevant band to strictly beyond it.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives no separate numerical definition of 'decisively'.

assumptions.choice: A long exits when the close crosses from at or above the SMA to below it; a short exits when it crosses from at or below the SMA to above it.
assumptions.reason: This is the literal directional interpretation of crossing back through the SMA.

assumptions.choice: After entry fills, a Backtrader stop order is placed 2% below the long entry fill or 2% above the short entry fill.
assumptions.reason: A stop order most directly implements a stop loss being hit using available OHLC data.
